description.value:
Requirements A mine you deployed is within 150 feet.

With a moment's thought, you trigger the detonation of a mine you deployed within 150 feet, causing it to explode in a @Template[type:burst|distance:resolve(ternary(gte(@actor.level,15),20,ternary(gte(@actor.level,10),15,10)))]. A mine deals your choice of either @Damage[(1+ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage or @Damage[(1+ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage. Creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save against your class DC.

You can Detonate Mine as a reaction r, with the following trigger: Trigger A creature enters or leaves a square within 10 feet of a mine you've deployed. If your mine has a larger radius, increase this distance to that amount.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6. At 10th level, the burst radius increases to 15 feet, and at 15th level, the burst radius increases to 20 feet.
